name: Listening Post
author: Jeremy Longshore
description: Listening Post turns 29 curated AI-vendor sources into one release radar, so model launches, pricing changes, status incidents, and engineering posts stop hiding across feeds. The bar hides until something needs attention. Open four keyboard-ready lanes to check ages, follow links, refresh, or mark items read. Same-week releases collapse into one row, and providers you use rise first. Its fixed HTTPS sources refresh every 15 minutes. No account, token, telemetry, article bodies, or custom hosts.
